spans.s: --the brown cow fit for gift in honour of the sun; the giver attains Golokam--details described. M. ९३. ६०. ८०; १०५. १६; २०

--an Asura friend of Kamsa; in the form of an ass jealously guarded the palmyra forest near ब्रिन्दा- vana. At the desire of his cowherd friends to eat the fruits of that palm grove, बलराम entered it and brought down fruits; the Asura came down and kicked him in his chest; he caught hold of him and whirled him to death; his kith and kin, other asses came and were dashed against trees; killed by कृष्ण.
1: भा.

. २४; 4. 2. ch. 8. (whole).
A दानव king,
2: Br. IV. २९. १२४.
with मनुष्य धर्म।
3: वा. ६८. १५; Vi.
